scope: V1 Prometheus metrics, latency metric definitions, histogram queries and OpenTelemetry tracing.

claims.claim: vLLM exposes Prometheus-compatible production metrics through the /metrics endpoint on the OpenAI-compatible API server.
claims.notes: The exact metric set depends on version, task, optional features and deployment mode.

claims.claim: Current V1 metrics include time_to_first_token_seconds, inter_token_latency_seconds, request_time_per_output_token_seconds, e2e_request_latency_seconds and request_queue_time_seconds histograms.
claims.notes: Check the target instance's /metrics output before writing alerts or dashboards.

claims.claim: ITL measures time between successive streamed output events, while request-level TPOT is computed per request as (end-to-end latency minus TTFT) divided by output token count minus one.
claims.notes: The values can differ when an output event bundles multiple tokens or when aggregation weights differ.

claims.claim: Custom histogram bucket families replace default boundaries; each additional bucket adds time series per metric and label combination, increasing Prometheus storage and scrape costs.
claims.locator: Custom Histogram Buckets and Bucket cardinality
claims.notes: Keep bucket lists short and use only for actively monitored metrics.

claims.claim: vLLM supports OpenTelemetry tracing configured with --otlp-traces-endpoint and detailed trace collection options.
claims.notes: Detailed tracing can add overhead; enable and sample based on operational need.

claims.claim: The chapter's histogram_quantile PromQL examples are derived from Prometheus histogram query semantics and the documented vLLM histogram metric names.
claims.notes: Aggregation labels should be adapted to labels actually exposed by the deployment.
